title: Petropavlivska Borshchahivka clashes: Parents of injured 14-year-old face scrutiny by child services
summary: The Child Services Department has held a preventive meeting with the parents of a 14-year-old boy who was injured during the events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka.

title: New phase of search operations begins in Puzhnyky, Ternopil region
summary: Ukrainian and Polish specialists are continuing the search for the remains of people killed during World War II on the site of the former village of Puzhnyky in the Ternopil region.

title: Russia stockpiles up to 700 ballistic missiles, several thousand cruise missiles – Ukrainian intelligence
summary: As of October 2026, Russia had stockpiled up to 700 ballistic missiles and several thousand cruise missiles.

title: Death toll from airstrike on Komyshuvakha rises to 42, search operations continue
summary: The death toll in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, following a Russian airstrike has risen to 42.

title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Chernihiv region
summary: Russian forces continue to target energy infrastructure in Ukraine's Chernihiv region.

title: Russian forces shell Marhanets, four injured
summary: Russian forces launched an artillery strike on the city of Marhanets in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring four people.

title: Ryazan under massive drone attack: Fire breaks out at one of Russia's largest oil refineries, Wildberries warehouse
summary: A local oil refinery in the Russian city of Ryazan, which supplies aviation fuel and diesel to the Russian military, caught fire following a drone attack.

title: Debris from Russian drone falls in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district
summary: Debris from a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle fell in an open area in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district.

title: Russian attack damages college, warehouse and energy infrastructure in Odesa region
summary: A Russian attack in the southern Odesa region partially destroyed a delivery company's warehouse and damaged energy infrastructure and an educational institution.

title: War update: 184 combat engagements on front line over past day
summary: A total of 184 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defence Forces and Russian forces were recorded along the frontline on November 5.

title: ADF neutralises 105 Russian drones since yesterday evening
summary: Ukraine's air defence forces neutralised 105 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 4.

title: Russian army attacks logistics infrastructure in Bucha, one injured
summary: Russian forces attacked logistics infrastructure in the Bucha district of Kyiv region, leaving one person injured.

title: Russia loses another 2,380 troops in war against Ukraine over past day
summary: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, reached approximately 1,599,390 personnel as of November 5, 2026, including 2,380 troops over the past 24 hours.

title: Russian drones attack Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring three, damaging critical infrastructure
summary: Russian drones attacked the cities of Dnipro and Samar, injuring three people and causing fires at critical infrastructure facilities.

title: Unexploded Kh-101 cruise missile discovered in Mykolaiv region
summary: An unexploded Kh-101 cruise missile was discovered in the Voznesensk district of Ukraine's Mykolaiv region.

title: Defence Forces destroy more than 8,000 Russian drones and missiles in October
summary: Ukraine's Defence Forces destroyed more than 8,000 Russian drones and missiles while repelling large-scale enemy attacks in October 2026. They also neutralised more than 43,000 tactical-level unmanned aerial vehicles.

title: USF destroys Russian Tunguska air defence system
summary: Operators from the 4th Battalion of the 413th Separate Regiment of the Unmanned Systems Forces, known as Raid, destroyed a Russian Tunguska surface-to-air missile and anti-aircraft artillery system.

title: Russian attack causes fire at warehouse in Bucha district
summary: An air attack by Russian forces caused a fire at a warehouse in the Bucha district.

title: Defence Forces strike Russian Pantsir-S1 air defence system worth $15M
summary: Ukraine's Defence Forces have struck a Russian Pantsir-S1 air defence system in the North Slobozhanskyi direction.

title: Russian drone carrying propaganda leaflets with phishing QR code shot down over Ukraine
summary: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces shot down a Russian Shahed-type drone over Ukraine on the evening of November 4. Along with its warhead, the drone was carrying propaganda leaflets containing a phishing QR code.

title: Lubinets explains assistance provided to residents evacuated from Oleshky
summary: Residents of Oleshky who have fled to territory controlled by Ukraine are receiving comprehensive assistance, and temporary housing options have been arranged for them.
